title: Concept: ASP.NET trace or ELMAH handler exposed
description: A reference to trace.axd or elmah.axd in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: trace.axd dumps every recent request with its headers, session and server variables, and elmah.axd lists every unhandled exception with its stack; both are unauthenticated by default.
applicability: ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core deployments with tracing or ELMAH left enabled.
risk: The trace lists session identifiers and form values from other users' requests.
